(1) Sysmon file-create (event 2) stacking returned only OS/AppX artefacts (USOPrivate update store, ContentDeliveryManager creatives, Cortana caches, systemprofile AppData blobs) — no Cookies/Login Data/Web Data files. (2) A targeted ES|QL search for file paths matching *cookies*/*login data*/*web data*/*cookies.sqlite* returned exactly one hit: svchost.exe creating C:\Windows\ServiceProfiles\LocalService\...\AC\INetCookies, a normal Windows service-profile artefact. (5) The 4104 script blocks matching *cookie*/*session*/*token*/*browser* were benign module manifests/localized strings on newyork (SYSTEM) plus pbeesly's CIM-session aliases and a Get-Process -IncludeUserName session enumeration on scranton/nashua — no cookie extraction code. (6) The suspicious pbeesly activity on scranton (Invoke-ScreenCapture, Invoke-Exfil with 7Zip4Powershell and a WebDAV copy to \\192.168.0.4\webdav) and the PyInstaller python.exe on nashua beaconing to 192.168.0.4:8443 are collection/exfiltration tradecraft, not web-session-cookie theft. function Invoke-BeachCleanup {
    Write-Host "[*] Cleaning up"

}
